title: Plumbing Pipe Routing 3D Editor
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a fully interactive 3D plumbing pipe routing editor using Three.js (CDN). The editor allows users to place pipe nodes in 3D space, connect them with cylindrical pipe segments, select/delete segments, undo/redo actions, and validate the pipe network for flow constraints.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a perspective camera at position (10, 12, 10) looking at origin.
- Add OrbitControls for camera manipulation.
- Add a 20x20 grid helper on the XZ plane as the floor reference.
- Ambient light (intensity 0.4) + directional light from (5, 10, 5) intensity 0.8.
- Background color #1a1a2e.
- All pipe nodes are rendered as spheres (radius 0.25, color #00ff88). The currently hovered/selected node glows #ffaa00.
- Pipe segments are rendered as CylinderGeometry tubes (radius 0.1) connecting two nodes, colored #4488ff. Selected segments turn #ff4444.
- Each node snaps to an integer grid (x, y, z all integers from -9 to 9, y from 0 to 9).

MODES & INTERACTIONS:
- The editor has 3 modes: 'place' (default), 'connect', 'select'. Display current mode in a HUD.
- Press '1' to enter Place mode. Click on the grid floor (raycast to XZ plane at y=0) to place a new node snapped to nearest integer position. Hold Shift+Click to place at elevated y (cycle through y=0,1,2,3 with each Shift+Click at same XZ).
- Press '2' to enter Connect mode. Click a node to start a connection, click another node to complete it. A pipe segment is created between them. Prevent duplicate connections between same two nodes. Calculate and store the pipe length (Euclidean distance between nodes).
- Press '3' to enter Select mode. Click a pipe segment to select it (highlight red). Press Delete/Backspace to remove the selected segment.
- Press 'Ctrl+Z' to undo the last action (place node, connect, delete). Press 'Ctrl+Y' to redo.
- Maximum 20 nodes and 30 segments allowed.

FLOW VALIDATION:
- Add a DOM button 'Validate Network'. When clicked, check: (1) all nodes must have at least 1 connection (no orphans), (2) the network must be fully connected (single connected component via BFS/DFS), (3) total pipe length must not exceed 50 units. Store validation result.

TOTAL LENGTH & STATS:
- Continuously compute totalPipeLength as sum of all segment lengths.
- Display in HUD: node count, segment count, total pipe length (2 decimal places), current mode, validation status.

STATE MANAGEMENT - window.__3D_STATE__ must expose:
- mode: string ('place'|'connect'|'select')
- nodes: array of {id, x, y, z} objects
- segments: array of {id, fromNodeId, toNodeId, length} objects
- nodeCount: number
- segmentCount: number
- totalPipeLength: number (sum of all segment lengths)
- selectedSegmentId: number|null
- connectStartNodeId: number|null (the first node clicked in connect mode)
- lastAction: string ('place_node'|'connect_segment'|'delete_segment'|'undo'|'redo'|'none')
- undoStackSize: number
- redoStackSize: number
- validationResult: {orphanFree: bool, fullyConnected: bool, lengthOK: bool, valid: bool}|null
- nextNodeId: number (auto-increment counter for node IDs)
- nextSegmentId: number (auto-increment counter for segment IDs)

All state fields must update synchronously after each action. Ensure no NaN values in any coordinate or length field.
physics_constraints: Nodes must snap to integer grid coordinates. Pipe lengths must equal exact Euclidean distance between connected nodes. Total pipe length is the sum of all individual segment lengths and must be conserved across undo/redo cycles. No duplicate connections between the same pair of nodes. Network validation must use proper graph traversal (BFS/DFS) for connectivity checking.
